title: Insert Middleware Before or After Existing Laravel Middleware
content:
Laravel 13.40 adds insertBefore() and insertAfter() to place middleware next to built-in ones like TrustProxies and StartSession without redefining the stack.

The post Insert Middleware Before or After Existing Laravel Middleware appeared first on Laravel News.
